confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear pattern of an insider threat (user_02) performing extensive data collection. The user accessed and downloaded files from multiple departments (DevOps, Legal, HR, Finance, Sales, Marketing) that are entirely outside their authorized scope of engineering and shared project directories.

attack_chain.description: User_02 logs in from a normal IP (192.168.1.102) during off-hours (08:12).
User_02 begins unauthorized cross-department access by downloading a file from the DevOps directory.
User_02 expands scope to access and read files in the Legal directory.
User_02 downloads files from the HR directory.
User_02 downloads files from the Sales directory.
User_02 accesses the Marketing directory, completing a broad sweep of departmental data.

gaps: Lack of information regarding whether user_02 had a legitimate cross-departmental project assignment or ticket that would justify this access.
No information on whether the downloaded files were subsequently moved to an external location or personal storage.
narrative: User_02, a senior developer, engaged in a systematic pattern of unauthorized data collection by accessing and downloading files from nearly every department in the organization, including DevOps, Legal, HR, Finance, Sales, and Marketing. This behavior, occurring during off-hours and involving directories far outside their normal scope, strongly indicates an insider threat or compromised account performing data exfiltration.
